name: craftos-mcp
description: A headless CC:Tweaked 1.101.3 emulator for ComputerCraft Lua: run programs, touch monitors, run tests. Bundles the cc-tweaked-dev skill and the MCP server.

addons.title: Mods to simulate
addons.description: Which mods besides CC:Tweaked your modpack has: "all", "none", or ids separated by commas (advanced-peripherals, mekanism, mekanism-generators, create, create-additions, toms-peripherals, bigger-reactors, extreme-reactors, unlimited-peripheral-works, metaphysics, some-peripherals, cloud-solutions, cccbridge, create-cc-logistics, cc-liftlink, cc-vs, cc-shops, cc-androids, cc-drones, cc-drones-plus, ac-drones, advanced-math, lectern-hub, crickets-peripherals, cctech, embedded-computer, lakes-cc-additions, sc-peripherals, ccsecureboot, ccx, directgpu, cide, plethora, cc-link, finer-peripherals, ducky-peripherals, more-peripherals, classic-peripherals). Each runs only on the Minecraft versions its mod came out for.
